Destinations._comment: Silos is a tenant domain -> dedicated-silo base address map (XD01-289), one entry per Tier-2 pilot tenant provisioned with its own silo deployment. A request whose X-Tenant-Domain header doesn't match any configured entry falls through to Shared, never to another tenant's silo. The one example entry below matches this repo's docker-compose default silo service names. Routes (GatewayRouteCatalog, XD01-384): /api/geoassets/**, /api/ip-billing/**, /api/field-service/** forwarded as they are; /api/v/neutral-operator/** -> NeutralOperator with the prefix rewritten to /api/** (query string kept); every other /api/** plus /wms and /wfs -> GeoAssets (the kernel catch-all, lowest precedence).

NeutralOperator._comment: XD01-384: GeoAssets.NeutralOperator.Server (ADR-001 Phase 7). Rollback of the cut-over: point Shared (and each silo) at the kernel (the GeoAssets destination) and list 'neutral-operator' again in the kernel's GeoAssets:Modules — the kernel-hosted module serves the same /api/workflow routes, so the same /api/v/neutral-operator/** -> /api/** rewrite reaches it. See deploy/neutral-operator/README.md.

Cors._comment: XD01-384: the browser origins (the Blazor Web app) allowed to call the gateway — the same setting, and the same policy (any header, any method), as GeoAssets.Server's. The gateway is the one CORS authority: it answers preflights itself and drops the backends' Access-Control-* response headers.

RateLimiting._comment: Per-OrganizationId token bucket (XD01-214) — mitigates one tenant's burst traffic (e.g. a batch mobile photo upload) degrading others sharing the same clusters. TokenLimit is the bucket's max size; TokensPerPeriod tokens are added back every ReplenishmentPeriodSeconds. OrganizationIdClaimType is unset by default (every caller shares one bucket) until an operator's CIAM tenant emits a real organization claim — set it to that claim's type. Requests without a resolvable organization (anonymous WMS tiles included) share the one 'unresolved' bucket; /healthz is never limited.
